namespace = cc_xp

###############################################################################
# GENERATED FILE. Do not edit by hand.
#   python tools/generate_ladders.py
#
# One event per ladder branch point. Fired by cc_xp_ladder_advance when a HUMAN
# court's minister has earned a rung that offers a choice of destination.
#
# The advancement has NOT happened yet when this opens: each option performs its
# own trait swap. There is deliberately no dismiss option, because closing the
# event without choosing would strand the minister on the old rung with the
# cooldown unspent, and the event would simply fire again next year.
#
# Each event identifies its minister by the trait they are LEAVING as well as the
# cc_xp_branch_pending flag, so two ministers branching in the same year cannot
# resolve into each other.
#
#   cc_xp.20   [adm] fiscal: loyal_steward -> prosperity_planner | treasury_enforcer
#   cc_xp.21   [adm] learning: progressive_rationalist -> enlightenment_herald | humanist_philosopher
#   cc_xp.22   [adm] law: efficiency_administrator -> estate_guardian | regional_magnate
#   cc_xp.23   [adm] integration: seasoned_integrator -> master_integrator | iron_integrator
#   cc_xp.24   [dip] envoy: tentative_envoy -> tactful_envoy | diplomatic_attache
#   cc_xp.25   [dip] trade: merchant_syndic -> mercantilist_official | free_market_advocate
#   cc_xp.26   [mil] command: tactical_advisor -> offensive_strategist | defensive_commander
#   cc_xp.27   [mil] command: offensive_strategist -> supreme_commander | continental_marshal
#   cc_xp.28   [mil] command: defensive_commander -> supreme_commander | continental_marshal
###############################################################################


# The Treasury: loyal_steward -> prosperity_planner or treasury_enforcer
cc_xp.20 = {
	type = country_event
	title = cc_xp.20.title
	desc = cc_xp.20.desc
	outcome = positive

	illustration_tags = {
		10 = interior
	}

	trigger = {
		any_character = {
			has_trait = loyal_steward
			has_variable = cc_xp_branch_pending
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_character = {
			limit = {
				has_trait = loyal_steward
				has_variable = cc_xp_branch_pending
			}
			remove_variable = cc_xp_branch_pending
			save_scope_as = cc_xp_subject
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = cc_xp.20.a
		scope:cc_xp_subject = {
			remove_trait = trait:loyal_steward
			set_variable = { name = cc_granting_trait  value = yes }
			add_trait = trait:prosperity_planner
			remove_variable = cc_granting_trait
			cc_xp_stamp_advance = yes
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = cc_xp.20.b
		scope:cc_xp_subject = {
			remove_trait = trait:loyal_steward
			set_variable = { name = cc_granting_trait  value = yes }
			add_trait = trait:treasury_enforcer
			remove_variable = cc_granting_trait
			cc_xp_stamp_advance = yes
		}
	}
}
